blocks.title: About
blocks.introHtml: I work where generative models, systems, and graphics meet.
blocks.name: Hwan Heo
blocks.bodyHtml:
At NC AI, I lead research and engineering for the VARCO 3D team, developing production 3D AI systems across large-scale generative model training, inference optimization, and graphics algorithms.

When I'm away from CUDA kernels and mesh pipelines, I'm usually playing guitar, making music, or following an unexpected STEM rabbit hole.
